payload.summary: Third-party publisher documents: downloads now admin-only; answer-corpus narrowing still waits on counsel
payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-27 (checked against main df306fc1): the download half (R-05) is done. Commits d6586d81 and 92ffcae5 (26 Oct, owner decision) limit third-party original files to administrators by default. Still open (R-06): third-party text stays in the public answer corpus. Narrowing public_corpus is a live database change that needs the owner's named yes, after counsel answers on licences. PRIOR DETAIL: Migration 20260706120000 made all indexed documents public. Narrowing public_corpus is a live database change needing the owner's named yes for that specific change; await counsel's answer on licences first. Findings R-05, R-06.
